user.title: Set up Icelandic Met Office Weather
user.description: Could not load the station list.

menu.title: Set up weather
menu.description: Use Home/person weather with no station selection, or add optional station weather.

settings.title: Weather entity settings
settings.description: Choose which automatic weather entities to create. You can add stations now or later from the integration options.

data.enable_device_tracker_weather: Create weather for selected device trackers
data.enable_derived_forecasts: Enable derived daily and twice-daily forecasts

data_description.enable_derived_forecasts: Vedur.is exposes timed XML forecast points. Daily and twice-daily forecasts are summaries derived by this integration, not native Vedur.is forecast products.

search_place.title: Search for a place
search_place.description: Enter an Icelandic place name. The next step will open the map at that location so you can adjust it before selecting nearby stations. Place search is provided by OpenStreetMap Nominatim.

select_place.title: Choose matching place
select_place.description: Choose the matching place. The next step will open the map at that location.

nearby.title: Find nearby stations
nearby.description: Choose a location on the map. The next step will show the nearest weather stations.

nearby_select.title: Select nearby stations
nearby_select.description: Choose from the nearest stations. The next step lets you review integration options before saving.

select.title: Select stations
select.description: Choose optional station weather entities. The next step lets you review integration settings before saving.

error.already_configured: One or more selected stations are already configured.
error.invalid_response: The Icelandic Met Office weather API returned an unexpected response.
error.invalid_location: The selected location was not valid.
error.no_stations: No active automatic stations matched the search.
error.place_not_found: No matching Icelandic place was found.

init.title: Manage Icelandic Met Office Weather
init.description: Could not load the station list.

menu.title: Configure weather
menu.description: Choose what you want to change.

settings.title: Weather entity settings
settings.description: Change which automatic weather entities are created. This does not change the selected station list.

data.enable_device_tracker_weather: Create weather for selected device trackers
data.enable_derived_forecasts: Enable derived daily and twice-daily forecasts

data_description.enable_derived_forecasts: Vedur.is exposes timed XML forecast points. Daily and twice-daily forecasts are summaries derived by this integration, not native Vedur.is forecast products.

search_place.title: Search for a place
search_place.description: Enter an Icelandic place name. The next step will open the map at that location so you can adjust it before selecting nearby stations. Place search is provided by OpenStreetMap Nominatim.

select_place.title: Choose matching place
select_place.description: Choose the matching place. The next step will open the map at that location.

nearby.title: Find nearby stations
nearby.description: Choose a location on the map. The next step will show the nearest weather stations.

nearby_select.title: Select nearby stations
nearby_select.description: Choose nearby stations to add. Existing stations are kept unless you remove them from Manage station list.

select.title: Manage station list
select.description: Add or remove selected station weather entities. This does not change weather entity settings.

get_forecast_for_location.name: Get forecast for location
get_forecast_for_location.description: Return the nearest Vedur observation station and XML forecast for a latitude/longitude without creating entities.

type.name: Forecast type
type.description: Choose hourly XML points or derived daily/twice-daily summaries.
